title: HTML: Structure a workshop card
instructions: Give this page one main region, one h1, a Preparation h2, and an unordered list with three items. Keep the text readable without CSS.
hint: Use main for the primary content. Put each equipment item inside its own li, within one ul.

title: HTML: Label a required field
instructions: Connect a visible Email address label to the email input, make the field required, and add a submit button. Preview submissions stay local and are blocked.
hint: The label for value must match the input id. Set type="email" and include required.

solution.html:
<form>
  <label for="email">Email address</label>
  <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required>
  <button type="submit">Register</button>
</form>

checks.label: Email input has a programmatic label and is required

checks.name: type
checks.label: Email input uses the email type

title: CSS: Arrange action buttons
instructions: Use Flexbox on .actions. Make the buttons wrap, with a 16px gap. Resize the preview to see how the row behaves.
hint: Set display: flex, flex-wrap: wrap, and gap: 16px on the container, not on each button.

title: CSS: Build a three-column grid
instructions: Use Grid to arrange six cards in three equal columns with a 12px gap. Use minmax(0, 1fr) so long content can shrink within a column.
hint: The container needs display: grid and grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)).

title: JavaScript: Count button clicks
instructions: Make each click on #increment increase #count by one. Use addEventListener and update textContent. Check starts from a fresh preview and clicks once.
hint: Keep a numeric count outside the listener; increment it inside the click handler and write it to the output.

title: JavaScript: Filter a fruit list
instructions: Filter the list while typing, ignoring letter case. Set each li.hidden according to whether its text includes the query. Check types AP and expects Apple and Apricot.
hint: Listen for input, lowercase both the query and item text, and set hidden to the opposite of includes(query).

checks.label: Uppercase AP shows Apple and Apricot, and hides Banana
